title: UI Overhaul & Permanent Memory
changes: Completely redesigned the application layout, replacing the bulky left sidebars with a sleek, space-saving Top Menu Bar.
Introduced the Permanent Memory DB integration. The system now autonomously saves verified architectural logic and physics/math proofs to the G:\ drive.
Implemented a true 'Autonomous ReAct Loop'. The LLM can now run Polyglot Python scripts in the sandbox, read the terminal output, and self-correct errors.
Added an automated 'What's New' Changelog Modal to track version history.

title: Omni-Context & Local Scanners
changes: Integrated the Vault Auto-Scanner daemon to continuously sweep all internal hard drives (C:\, G:\, S:\, F:\, D:\) for Markdown documents.
Implemented Omni-Context Hybrid Retrieval. The AI now pulls data simultaneously from live Web Searches, local Vector Vaults, and the OmniDrive SQLite Database.

title: Cognitive Engine Initialization
changes: Connected the backend FastApi server with the Python execution environment.
Implemented initial UI tabs for Media Studio, Developer Workspace, and Fire Writing.

title: Alpha Release
changes: Initial build of the Stehouwer Publishing Bullshit AI.
Basic Chat interface connected to the local Ollama daemon.
